name: 柔和生活方式

typography.display: 人文无衬线或开源衬线替代

foundations.spacing: 4px 基线，20px 移动端边距，40px 内容节奏
foundations.elevation: 非常轻的柔阴影，仅用于浮层
foundations.grid: 单列阅读优先，桌面最大行宽 72ch
foundations.motion: 200ms 温和转场，不依赖动画理解内容

components.button: 圆角主操作配清晰文字，次操作保持线性
components.card: 信息有限的独立项目，避免卡片套卡片
components.navigation: 移动端优先，当前页有文字和颜色双重提示
components.form: 单题一步，保留明确帮助文案
components.dialog: 轻量短流程，关闭和返回始终可见

visualLanguage.photography: 自然光、真诚日常场景、无文字无 logo
visualLanguage.illustration: 少量角色或手绘质感承载情绪，不承担操作

contentVoice: 温和但不含糊，用具体下一步取代空泛鼓励。
accessibility: 保持可读对比度；动效提供 reduced-motion；触摸目标不低于 44px。
dos: 一次推进一个清楚动作
让情绪性图片和真实文案分层
donts: 不要以品牌名或商标生成图片
不要让柔色降低关键文字的可读性

en.name: Gentle Lifestyle

typography.display: Humanist sans serif or an open-source serif alternative

foundations.radius: 10px for images and lightweight content groups
foundations.elevation: A very soft shadow used only for overlays
foundations.grid: Single-column reading first, with a 72ch maximum desktop line length
foundations.motion: 200ms gentle transitions; understanding never depends on animation

components.button: Rounded primary actions with clear copy; secondary actions remain linear
components.card: A bounded item with limited information; avoid cards nested inside cards
components.navigation: Mobile-first, with both text and color indicating the current page
components.form: One question per step with explicit helper copy
components.dialog: Short, lightweight flows where close and back remain visible

visualLanguage.photography: Natural light and sincere everyday scenes, with no text or logos
visualLanguage.illustration: A few characters or hand-drawn textures carry emotion but never actions
visualLanguage.iconography: A consistent, restrained set of coded icons

en.contentVoice: Gentle but unambiguous, replacing vague encouragement with one concrete next step.
en.accessibility: Maintain readable contrast, provide reduced motion, and keep touch targets at least 44px.
dos: Advance one clear action at a time
Keep emotional imagery separate from real copy
donts: Do not generate images from brand names or trademarks
Do not let soft colors reduce the readability of critical copy
